detail.longDescription: I'm running into an issue with hosting some code on an AWS Lambda. I'm trying to run a project on a Lambda with the following file structure: my_layer.zip/ └── python/ # This folder name is mandatory └── my_package/ # Actual package folder ├── __init__.py # Required so Python treats it as a package └── other_subdirectories ├── __init__.py └── file_I_wanna_use.py I then want to call functions in file_I_wanna_use.py from the lambda, but am running into a module my_layer.file_I_wanna_use has no attribute class_I_wanna_use error I believe this is because the structure of the code in the layer shown above is incorrect in some way, but can't figure out why exactly.
